content:
UNRAR_SRC_DIR="$SRC/unrar"
make CXX=$CXX CXXFLAGS="$CXXFLAGS -fPIC" -C $UNRAR_SRC_DIR lib
rm -v $UNRAR_SRC_DIR/libunrar.so
$CXX $CXXFLAGS -I. $UNRAR_SRC_DIR/unrar_fuzzer.cc -o $OUT/unrar_fuzzer      -D_FILE_OFFSET_BITS=64 -D_LARGEFILE_SOURCE -DRAR_SMP -DRARDLL      -lFuzzingEngine -L$UNRAR_SRC_DIR -lunrar
../src-vul/afl/afl-cmin
../src-vul/afl/afl-plot
../src-vul/afl/afl-whatsup
../src-vul/afl/qemu_mode/build_qemu_support.sh
../src-vul/honggfuzz/tools/createStackBlacklist.sh
../src-vul/libfuzzer/build.sh
../src-vul/libfuzzer/scripts/unbalanced_allocs.py
/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/unrar
